entries.name: billing-direct-privileges
entries.claim: The serving role has no direct rate or assignment table grant.
entries.original: REVOKE ALL ON platform.billing_rate_tables, platform.billing_list_assignments FROM north_star_runtime;
entries.replacement: REVOKE ALL ON platform.billing_list_assignments FROM north_star_runtime;

test.namePattern: ^the serving role has no direct billing table privileges$

kills.name: the serving role has no direct billing table privileges

entries.name: billing-window-publication
entries.claim: A backdated publication cannot replace terms pinned at first allocation.

test.namePattern: ^publication after first allocation never reprices that window$

kills.name: publication after first allocation never reprices that window

entries.name: billing-booking-microseconds
entries.claim: Booking hands Billing its microsecond instants through the service-use protocol truncated to the millisecond.

test.namePattern: ^Booking microsecond instants truncate toward the past to the Billing millisecond$

kills.name: Booking microsecond instants truncate toward the past to the Billing millisecond
kills.expected: Booking time exceeds the Billing precision

entries.name: billing-booking-live-leg
entries.claim: A live use leg keeps the hire open past its agreed end.

test.namePattern: ^a live use leg past the agreed end keeps earning completed cycles$

kills.name: a live use leg past the agreed end keeps earning completed cycles
kills.expected: a live use leg keeps the service open

entries.name: billing-booking-overrun
entries.claim: A hire returned after its agreed end bills through the recorded return.

test.namePattern: ^possession past the agreed end bills through the recorded return$

kills.name: possession past the agreed end bills through the recorded return
kills.expected: the final cycle ends at the recorded return

entries.name: billing-role-required
entries.claim: Optional free text cannot carry the customer or currency role.

test.namePattern: ^the plan binds its customer and currency by declared role, not by field name$

kills.name: the plan binds its customer and currency by declared role, not by field name
kills.expected: optional notes cannot be the customer

entries.name: billing-role-currency-code
entries.claim: The currency role holds exactly one three-letter code.

test.namePattern: ^the plan binds its customer and currency by declared role, not by field name$

kills.name: the plan binds its customer and currency by declared role, not by field name
kills.expected: a currency holds one three-letter code

entries.name: billing-role-distinct
entries.claim: One field cannot carry both the customer and the currency role.

test.namePattern: ^the plan binds its customer and currency by declared role, not by field name$

kills.name: the plan binds its customer and currency by declared role, not by field name
kills.expected: one field cannot carry both roles

entries.name: billing-booking-possession-wired
entries.claim: The released quote query sets the hire service end from actual use (Booking through the service-use protocol).

test.namePattern: ^an equipment hire reviews possession Booking stamped on its production clock through the released quote query$

kills.name: an equipment hire reviews possession Booking stamped on its production clock through the released quote query
kills.expected: a live hire past its end is open
